policy: Native macOS command, AppleScript, and tool execution must live in the shared ClawHostKit MacControlActionBroker unless listed here as a temporary migration exception.

entries.reason: Legacy Mac Utilities UI still owns several local utility actions while they are migrated into ClawHostKit MacControlActionBroker capability adapters.
Dictation text insertion still uses AppleScript fallback after the central permission broker check; migrate injection execution behind the Mac action broker or a dedicated text-injection broker.
Dictation media controls still use AppleScript for playback state and control; keep registered until a media-control capability adapter exists.
Dictation playback controls still use AppleScript for playback state and control; keep registered until a media-control capability adapter exists.
